blocks.title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
blocks.description: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

blocks.title: Char Slam Explode
blocks.description: Headline glyphs hold in a deterministic scatter, then reassemble with an overshooting slam and a three-frame landing shake.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Text split into glyphs for the scatter and slam.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Headline and glow color.

variables.label: Spread
variables.description: Distance and rotation of the scattered glyphs.

blocks.title: Chart Story
blocks.description: One chart builds from data in reading order and lands the exact supplied values: staggered bars, a left-to-right line with area fill, a sweeping donut, or filling progress bars, with an accented value callout on the emphasized datum.

variables.label: Chart type
variables.description: Chart form the data builds into.

variables.label: Data
variables.description: Comma-separated numbers; the chart lands exactly on these values.

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: Comma-separated labels, one per datum.

variables.label: Emphasize
variables.description: Index of the datum that takes the accent and the value callout. Clamped to the data range.

variables.label: Unit
variables.description: Suffix appended to every displayed value.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract color used by the emphasized datum and its callout.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Proof stats end on the still hold, so the default is none.

blocks.title: Chat Message
blocks.description: One message arrives on the measured entry - scale 0.75, 0.12s, growing from its sender's corner. The type is an enum switched like marker-highlight's style: a received or sent bubble with a real tail, a large emoji row, an image, or a link card with title and domain. The atom that chat-thread builds conversations from
blocks.author: Miao Yang

variables.label: Type
variables.description: Which message form arrives.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Bubble text, or the emoji row for the Emoji type.

variables.label: Card title
variables.description: Link-card title (Link card type only).
variables.default: HyperFrames — Write HTML, render pixel-perfect video

variables.label: Card domain
variables.description: Link-card domain line (Link card type only).

variables.label: Tail
variables.description: The bubble tail anchoring the message to its side.

variables.label: Delivered
variables.description: The receipt under a sent message.

blocks.title: Chat Thread
blocks.description: The measured conversation as one mountable scene at full fidelity: status bar, back badge, avatar and name pill, bubbles with real iMessage tails, a Delivered receipt, large emoji rows, a media placeholder, a link card, and typing dots holding the beat. Every message picks its type by prefix - recv:/sent: text, emoji: a large row, img media, card:Title~domain a link card - and heights are measured at mount so any thread fits
blocks.author: Miao Yang

variables.label: Contact
variables.description: Name in the thread header; the avatar shows its first letter.

variables.label: Unread badge
variables.description: Count in the back-button badge. 0 hides it.

variables.label: Messages
variables.description: Pipe-separated thread. Each entry picks its type by prefix: recv: or sent: for a text bubble, emoji: for a large emoji row, img for a media placeholder, card:Title~domain for a link card. Example: recv:hey|sent:look 👀|card:HyperFrames~hyperframes.heygen.com|emoji:🤯🤯🤯
variables.default: recv:what r u using for the launch video??|sent:wait look 👀|card:HyperFrames — Write HTML, render pixel-perfect video~hyperframes.heygen.com|recv:OMG IT'S HTML|emoji:🤯🤯🤯|sent:renders in 4K. no editor

variables.label: Beat
variables.description: Seconds between message arrivals.

variables.label: Typing dots
variables.description: Show the three-dot indicator before received messages.

variables.label: Delivered receipt
variables.description: Show Delivered under the last sent bubble, as iMessage does.

blocks.title: ChatGPT Exchange
blocks.description: A portrait ChatGPT-style exchange types and sends a prompt, streams an answer, assembles a comparison table, and scrolls back through the result
blocks.author: Jake Moran

blocks.title: Chromatic Aberration Wipe
blocks.description: A fast slide wipe with RGB channel split on peak frames.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: The direction the reveal travels; both scenes slide the same way and the wipe edge follows.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour family of the incoming scene's gradient.

variables.label: Aberration
variables.description: Multiplies the red/cyan channel split: 0 removes it, 1 is the stock strength, 2 doubles the offset and saturates the flash.

blocks.title: Chromatic Radial Split
blocks.description: Shader transition with chromatic aberration radial split

blocks.title: Chrome Orb
blocks.description: A mirror-chrome orb reflects a bright studio light, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Cinemagraph
blocks.description: A still photograph with one living region: the frame is frozen while a single feathered window keeps moving - here, steam rising over a cup - drawn from the seek time alone with a period that divides the duration, so the render loops seamlessly. Swap the placeholder scene for a freeze-frame still masked over a looping video to cinemagraph real footage.

blocks.title: Cinematic Zoom
blocks.description: Shader transition with dramatic zoom blur

blocks.title: Claude Exchange
blocks.description: A portrait Claude-style exchange types a prompt, works through search and reasoning steps, then streams a detailed answer with citations and actions
blocks.author: Jake Moran

blocks.title: Code 3D Extrude
blocks.description: Syntax-highlighted code on a lit, beveled 3D slab that rotates through real space and settles to a readable rest — true WebGL depth and lighting, not a 2D transform.

blocks.title: Code Diff
blocks.description: An edit shown as a colored diff — removed lines collapse in red, added lines expand in green.

blocks.title: Code Highlight Sweep
blocks.description: A highlight band sweeps across a target line while the surrounding context dims — draws the eye to one line.

blocks.title: Code Morph
blocks.description: One snippet transforms into another — tokens glide between positions, leavers fade out, enterers fade in. Shiki Magic Move re-driven as a paused GSAP timeline.

blocks.title: Code Particle Assemble
blocks.description: Thousands of GPU points scatter through space and fly to the exact glyph pixels of the code, resolving into readable syntax-highlighted text — a particle system, not a token tween.

blocks.title: Code Scroll To Line
blocks.description: The camera scrolls a long file to bring a target line to center and spotlights it — for walking through real modules.

blocks.title: Code Shader Dissolve
blocks.description: The code compiles into existence: a GPU fragment shader resolves it out of seeded noise with a chromatic dissolve front and edge glow, then holds crisp.

blocks.title: Code Slice Hero
blocks.description: A tiled headline surface flips cell by cell under a sweeping depth field to reveal the rear headline.

blocks.title: Code Snippet - Apple Terminal Pro
blocks.description: Apple Terminal Pro profile: black background with grey text and lime green cursor, per-character typing animation of a shell session.

blocks.title: Code Snippet - Dark 2026
blocks.description: VS Code workbench with per-character typing animation in the Dark 2026 theme. Full editor chrome with activity bar, sidebar, tabs, terminal, and status bar.

blocks.title: Code Snippet - Dark Modern
blocks.description: VS Code workbench with per-character typing animation in the Dark Modern theme. Full editor chrome with activity bar, sidebar, tabs, terminal, and status bar.

blocks.title: Code Terminal Run
blocks.description: A token-chrome terminal panel runs one command: the prompt line types deterministically behind an integer-cycle caret, executes after a beat, and output lines print one per cue before a fresh prompt appears.

variables.label: Prompt glyph
variables.description: Leading glyph before the command and the trailing prompt. Empty string hides it.

variables.label: Cadence
variables.description: Keystroke rhythm: uniform fixed steps or seeded human chunks.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds relative to mount start; cue N sets when output line N prints. Empty uses the authored rhythm.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color of the prompt glyph and caret.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Outgoing transition. Frame roots own transitions; none holds the end frame.

blocks.title: Code Typing
blocks.description: Token-streamed typing reveal with a caret that tracks the frontier — deterministic, no CSS animation.

blocks.title: Color Wheel
blocks.description: A wide gradient slides slowly through the colours of the rainbow. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Colorama Wipe
blocks.description: Headline reveal through a feathered, leaning wipe front that is blurred and colour-mapped as it passes, then settles to clean type and wipes off again — the After Effects masked-text + Compound Blur + Colorama 'shiny wipe' as a deterministic canvas effect on any text element

blocks.title: Comparison Split
blocks.description: Two full-bleed panels compare before and after states as a persistent divider wipes the vivid after layer over the muted before layer and rests at a configurable split.

variables.label: Split position
variables.description: Target resting position of the comparison divider.

variables.label: Orientation
variables.description: Axis and direction used by the comparison wipe.

variables.label: Before label
variables.description: Caption shown on the base before panel.

variables.label: After label
variables.description: Caption shown on the revealed after panel.

blocks.title: Confetti
blocks.description: A deterministic celebration burst with seeded particles and gravity.

blocks.title: Conic Progress Ring
blocks.description: A token-driven conic progress ring whose angular fill and center count settle together from one registered percentage.

variables.label: Progress
variables.description: Target angular fill from 0 to 100.

variables.label: Thickness
variables.description: Ring stroke thickness as a percent of the ring radius.

variables.label: Center label
variables.description: Numeric target shown in the center and counted in sync with the fill.

blocks.title: Constellation Hub
blocks.description: Feature nodes brighten in narration order as real-length SVG connectors draw outward from a fixed central hub, then settle into one lockup.

variables.label: Hub label
variables.description: Text displayed inside the fixed central hub.

variables.label: Feature nodes
variables.description: Comma-separated feature labels introduced in narration order.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds (from mount start) for each node reveal. Empty keeps the authored even spread.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Highlight color used by the hub, connectors, and active nodes.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts.

blocks.title: Cosmic Orb
blocks.description: An iridescent soap-bubble planet: a slowly spinning sphere of nebula bands, dust lanes and twinkling stars wrapped in a refracting glass limb with chromatic aberration at the edge.

blocks.title: Count Up
blocks.description: A token-native stat counter that eases between values, counting up or down, and lands with a restrained scale pulse.

variables.label: Start value
variables.description: First value shown by the count.

variables.label: End value
variables.description: Final value where the count lands.

variables.label: Prefix
variables.description: Optional text shown before the value.

variables.label: Suffix
variables.description: Optional text shown after the value.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used by the count.

variables.label: Glow
variables.description: Optional soft accent glow under the count. Off by default.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the landed value holds until the frame cuts.

blocks.title: Cross Warp Morph
blocks.description: Shader transition with cross-warped morphing

blocks.title: CTA Close
blocks.description: A display-scale action line lands per word and fills the frame with air, one generous CTA capsule pops beneath it with a single overshoot, and the finished close holds completely still.

variables.label: Action line
variables.description: Two to four word action that closes the film.

variables.label: Button label
variables.description: Text displayed inside the single CTA capsule.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract color used by the CTA capsule.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts (this primitive closes films).

blocks.title: CTA Lockup
blocks.description: A canonical closing lockup that reveals an action line, pops in an accent CTA capsule, settles supporting microcopy, and holds with confidence.

variables.label: Action line
variables.description: Primary action statement shown above the CTA.

variables.label: Button label
variables.description: Text displayed inside the CTA capsule.

variables.label: Microcopy
variables.description: Supporting detail shown below the CTA capsule.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Fill color used by the CTA capsule.

blocks.title: Cuboid Carousel
blocks.description: A chain of bevelled cuboids rides a travelling wave as a content carousel.

blocks.title: Annotate Cursor
blocks.description: A marker pen glides onto the frame and hand-draws a loose loop, an underline, or an arrow around a region, the ink laid exactly under its nib, then lifts and leaves.

blocks.title: Context Menu Cursor
blocks.description: A cursor right-clicks a file, a context menu blooms from its tip, the hover highlight tracks the item under it, and the chosen action plays out: duplicate, rename, move to trash, or a confirmation toast.

blocks.title: Drag and Drop Cursor
blocks.description: A cursor grabs a task card, lifts and tilts it into its motion, carries it in lockstep to an empty column, drops it with a small settle, and the list closes the gap behind it.

blocks.title: Cursor Glyph Trail
blocks.description: A tutorial cursor path: on a settings screen the arrow clicks through three steps, leaving a dotted trail spaced evenly by distance and a numbered marker at each click; each step's trail fades as the next move begins.

variables.label: Glyphs (deprecated)
variables.description: Deprecated and ignored: the trail draws evenly spaced dots.

variables.label: Density
variables.description: Spacing between trail dots.

variables.label: Path
variables.description: How each move bends: sweep is a gentle curve, arc a deeper one, zigzag a straight line.

variables.label: Fade
variables.description: Seconds a step trail takes to fade once the next move begins, clamped 0.3 to 1.5.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Trail and step marker color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the finished screen holds until the frame cuts.

blocks.title: Marquee Select Cursor
blocks.description: A cursor drags a selection rectangle across a photo grid; each tile rings and pops a check the frame the rectangle touches it, while a pill counts the selection up.

blocks.title: Text Select Cursor
blocks.description: An arrow turns into an I-beam over a document, drags a selection across a phrase character by character, raises a format toolbar, turns back into an arrow and clicks Bold.

variables.label: Paragraph
variables.default: Our spring release ships on Thursday. Teams can now share a live review link, collect time-stamped comments, and approve the final cut without leaving the editor. Early customers cut their review rounds in half.

blocks.title: Zoom Follow Cursor
blocks.description: Screen-recording auto-zoom: the camera pushes in toward each upcoming click, trails the cursor on a smooth spring, marks every click with a press and a ring, then eases back out to the full screen as the cursor leaves.

variables.label: Screenshot
variables.description: Your own screen capture. Leave empty for the built-in dashboard.

blocks.title: Curtain Reveal
blocks.description: Two pleated stage curtains gather outward from center, the way real velvet bunches at the tieback, revealing the stage underneath. A static pelmet frames the top; a soft spotlight can bloom in as they part.

variables.label: Curtain tone
variables.description: Curtain color.

variables.label: Pelmet
variables.description: Static valance framing the top of the stage.

variables.label: Spotlight
variables.description: Soft glow blooming over the stage as the curtains part.

blocks.title: Cut the Curve
blocks.description: A velocity-matched directional hard cut: the outgoing subject accelerates with power4.in, swaps at peak velocity, and the incoming subject continues in the same direction with power4.out.

variables.label: Subject
variables.description: Visual payload used on both sides of the cut.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Shared screen direction for outgoing and incoming travel.

variables.label: Cut fraction
variables.description: Normalized point where the hard cut swaps subjects.

variables.label: Cut blur
variables.description: Blur in pixels shared by both subjects at the cut seam.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure of the incoming subject. Default none: it rests until the frame cuts.

blocks.title: Dart Cursor
blocks.description: A bold outlined arrowhead that dives in from camera depth, flies nose-first with motion blur along its path, squashes on two clicks, and whips out of frame.

blocks.title: Data Chart
blocks.description: Animated bar + line chart with staggered reveal, NYT-style typography, and value labels

blocks.title: Decline Chart
blocks.description: A metric line draws downward as its value counts down and the ambient background darkens in lockstep.

variables.label: Metric label
variables.description: Label shown above the declining value.

variables.label: Start value
variables.description: Metric value at the start of the decline.

variables.label: End value
variables.description: Metric value at the bottom of the decline.

blocks.title: Device Frame Stage
blocks.description: A phone or tablet mockup staged as a physical scene prop with a screen slot for arbitrary reconstructed UI, rising onto the stage, settling, and holding an idle float

blocks.title: Directional Wipe
blocks.description: A directional scene push that slides one panel over another.

variables.label: Palette
variables.description: Theme token for the ring marking the incoming panel. Slate rides --accent, teal --brand, ember --accent-2; each falls back to a neutral hairline.

variables.label: Corner
variables.description: Corner radius of the transition card.

blocks.title: Domain Warp Dissolve
blocks.description: Shader transition with fractal noise domain warping

blocks.title: Drift Hold
blocks.description: A centered content card stays subtly alive through loop-exact rotation, scale breathing, and a slow light sweep.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Text displayed in the default centered card.

variables.label: Intensity
variables.description: Amplitude of the ambient rotation, breathing, and light sweep.

blocks.title: Dynamic Grid
blocks.description: A responsive animated grid background driven by CSS variables for SaaS, code, and data scenes

variables.label: Density
variables.description: Cell size of the grid: fine reads as graph paper, coarse as a few large panels.

variables.label: Weight
variables.description: Thickness of the grid lines, from a hairline rule to a bold structural grid.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Line colour: neutral is the translucent white the original ships with, and the accents ride --brand, --accent and --accent-2.

blocks.title: Echo Smear
blocks.description: Distance-adaptive streak — records each element's real trajectory (position, rotation, scale, opacity), then trails time-offset copies behind it in proportion to its speed, combined by brightest pixel, so fast moves smear and slow ones stay sharp; spinning edges stay smooth

blocks.title: Echo Trail
blocks.description: A moving element renders with N ghosted copies of itself at t minus i times delta, opacity stepped down per ghost; one traversal, echoes collapsing into the settled element at rest.

variables.label: Echoes
variables.description: Ghost copy count, clamped 2 to 6.

variables.label: Delta
variables.description: Lag between successive ghosts in seconds, clamped 0.03 to 0.3.

variables.label: Path
variables.description: Authored traversal preset.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Subject accent color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the settled element holds until the frame cuts.

blocks.title: Editorial Flash Overlay
blocks.description: Finite neutral-warm light layers for a seek-safe camera-flash cut or social reveal

blocks.title: Exploded Stack
blocks.description: Isometric layer plates explode apart with a label beside each layer, hold, then collapse back into one stack. Built for architecture and system diagrams.

blocks.title: Extended Keyframe
blocks.description: The never-fully-lands arrival: an element covers most of its move in the first fifth of the duration and creeps the rest to the last frame, exits along its arrival vector, and carries shutter motion blur — from any side or by scale, one call per element, plus the ease on its own for any tween

blocks.title: Extruded Logo
blocks.description: Beveled 3D letters flip up one by one, the word swings so light runs across the bevels, then settles for a readable hold. Chrome, gold or matte.

blocks.title: Facet Morph
blocks.description: A faceted low-poly mass of 36 triangles continuously reshapes between three authored silhouettes (blob, mark, badge) with per-facet flat shading that recomputes as the vertices move. Light reads from the upper left; lit facets lift toward a pale accent-tinted tone while turned-away facets fall toward near-black. One calm continuous morph, then a settled hold.

variables.label: Forms
variables.description: Comma-separated silhouette sequence from blob, mark, badge.

variables.label: Hold last
variables.description: True settles dead still on the final silhouette; false keeps the mass slowly breathing through the hold.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Tint of the lit facets.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Outgoing transition. None holds the settled mass.

blocks.title: Fade Through
blocks.description: A calm transition primitive that fades one layer out, passes through a wash, and reveals the next layer

variables.label: Wash
variables.description: Colour of the mid-transition frame. Paper resolves through --hf-fade-through-wash, accent rides --accent.

variables.label: Strength
variables.description: How far the wash covers at its peak. 1 is a full flash, 0.3 a light veil.

variables.label: Shape
variables.description: Flat fills the frame evenly, bloom concentrates the wash in the centre.

blocks.title: Falling Lines
blocks.description: White lines fall down the frame at varied speeds, each fading into a trail. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Filmed Screen
blocks.description: Your scene, filmed off a screen: perspective, depth of field that follows an element you name, LED sub-pixels and per-shot colour grades. Shots glide into each other, focus racks between elements, and the focused element stays sharp.

blocks.title: Flash Through White
blocks.description: Shader transition with white flash crossfade

blocks.title: Flowchart
blocks.description: Animated decision tree with SVG connectors, sticky-note nodes, cursor interaction, and typing correction

blocks.title: Flowchart Vertical
blocks.description: Portrait animated decision tree with SVG connectors, sticky-note nodes, cursor interaction, and typing correction

blocks.title: Flowing Gradient
blocks.description: Bands of orange and violet flow across the frame in a smooth gradient. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Focus Blur Resolve

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Type size of the words, from a caption-scale line to a full display card.

variables.label: Blur

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Highlight color shared by both cards.

blocks.title: Focus Swap
blocks.description: Moves attention between two side-by-side cards as one recedes with scale, blur, and dimming while the other advances to full focus.

variables.label: Final focus
variables.description: Card that ends sharp, full-size, and fully opaque.

variables.label: Unfocused blur
variables.description: Blur applied to the card outside the viewer focus.

variables.label: Unfocused opacity
variables.description: Opacity of the card outside the viewer focus.

blocks.title: Fractal Noise
blocks.description: Soft grey fractal noise drifts across the frame like slow clouds. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Freeze-Frame Dressing
blocks.description: Timeline-driven paper, tape, and flash dressing for a freeze-frame or background-removed subject

blocks.title: Frost
blocks.description: A frozen blue orb with frost creeping in from its edge, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Frost Sequence Camera Orbit
blocks.description: An orbiting camera follows an ice logo as it breaks apart, reforms into two text moments, and fades.

blocks.title: Gabor Noise
blocks.description: Grey streaky noise drifts across the frame like a moving fingerprint. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Gallery Tunnel
blocks.description: An infinite corridor of panels: a square tunnel receding to a vanishing point, its floor, ceiling and walls tiled with saturated colour slabs and caller-supplied images that swell toward camera and exit past you, the far end dissolving into fog.

Image share of filled slots (0 = all colour, 1 = all images)
Grid density: slots per wall face per axis (2 = 4 per face, 16 per segment)
Fog distance: depth at which the corridor reaches pure backdrop

variables.label: Response label

variables.label: Accent

blocks.title: Glass Hero
blocks.description: A solid glass object rises in front of a giant headline and keeps turning, so the type bends and splits into colour through it.

blocks.title: Glass Shard Title
blocks.description: Glass shards fly in through fog and tile themselves into the headline.

blocks.title: Glitch

blocks.title: Gloss Sweep

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Text displayed on the card.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color treatment for the card.

variables.label: Sweep angle
variables.description: Angle of the specular gloss in degrees.

blocks.title: Godrays
blocks.description: Rays of light fan out from a corner and drift across a deep blue field. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Goo
blocks.description: A glossy green liquid ball whose surface bulges and ripples like wet goo, centred on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Gooey Split
blocks.description: A dot splits into a three-dot menu with a gooey metaball neck, spins into a swirl mark under directional shutter motion blur, then breaks back into three dots and merges into one. The goo is an SVG blur-and-threshold filter on the dots; the blur integrates each part along its real trajectory, so the smear follows the direction and speed of the spin.

blocks.title: Grade Split Reveal
blocks.description: The same picture twice, one flat and one finished, with a hard edge sweeping between them. It stops in the middle long enough to compare, then commits and the graded look takes the frame. Both looks are real HyperFrames color grading run through the WebGL shader, so the preview and the render match.

variables.label: Look
variables.description: Grade carried by the upper copy, and the label printed over it. All three are real grading blocks handed to the shader, not CSS filters.

variables.label: Split point
variables.description: How far across the plate the edge stops to hold the comparison, before it commits and takes the rest.

variables.label: Edge
variables.description: The divider line riding the wipe. Hidden drops it entirely so the grade arrives with no seam.

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: Show or hide the two captions naming each half of the plate.

blocks.title: Grain Field
blocks.description: A clearly visible accent-tinted dot field drifts over a subtle luminance gradient in an exact ambient loop.

variables.label: Density
variables.description: Dot size and spacing across the grain field.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent token family used to color the dots and luminance wash.

blocks.title: Grain Overlay
blocks.description: Animated film grain texture overlay using CSS keyframes — adds warmth and analog character to any composition

blocks.title: Gravitational Lens
blocks.description: Shader transition with gravitational lensing distortion

blocks.title: Grid Card Assemble
blocks.description: N capability cards (thin-line icon that draws on, mono label, optional muted body) stagger-assemble into a grid or vertical list with a fade plus short slide into slot, then hold perfectly still.

variables.label: Items
variables.description: Comma-separated cards (3 to 12). "Label: body" adds a one-line muted body under the label.

variables.label: Layout
variables.description: Grid wraps by columns; list stacks vertically.

variables.label: Columns
variables.description: Grid column count (grid layout only). 0 picks automatically: one row up to 3 items, then ceil(sqrt(N)).

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated per-item entrance times in seconds. Blank entries use the default cascade.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent token family used by the card icons.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: How the assembled layout leaves the frame. Default none: the hold ends the film.

blocks.title: Grid Pixelate Wipe
blocks.description: Transition effect where the screen dissolves into a grid of squares that fade out with staggered timing — use between scenes

blocks.title: Halftone Dissolve
blocks.description: Scene A dissolves into scene B through a growing halftone dot field: accent ink dots pop onto a fixed grid smallest-first, each opens into a window onto B, until the windows merge and B fully replaces A.

variables.label: Dot size
variables.description: Grid pitch for the halftone field.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Threshold ordering: ltr sweeps left to right, center grows from the middle, noise scatters.

variables.label: Dissolve at
variables.description: Seconds from mount start when the dissolve begins.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Ink dot color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: scene B holds until the frame cuts.

blocks.title: Halftone Field
blocks.description: A full-bleed halftone light field: a grid of dots whose size and colour track a slow flowing simplex-noise field, so broad bands of light sweep across a mostly-black frame like a giant LED wall showing a plasma. Built to run under type.

blocks.title: Headline Slam
blocks.description: A heavyweight headline scales down into frame, lands with a deterministic three-frame shake, holds with subtle drift, and whips upward on exit.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Text displayed as the headline.

variables.label: Accent word index
variables.description: Zero-based word index to color. Out of range leaves the headline unaccented.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color applied to the selected word.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Drop shadow cast under the headline. On by default; set false for a flat matte look.

blocks.title: Heatmap
blocks.description: Thermal colours flow through a glowing orb, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: HeyGen Avatar Promo Card

blocks.author: HeyGen

blocks.title: Hologram
blocks.description: A pale blue holographic orb with scan rings and flicker, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Holographic
blocks.description: An iridescent foil orb with a shifting rainbow sheen, centred on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

blocks.title: Hand-Drawn Arrow
blocks.description: Wobbled draw-on arrow with straight, gentle, and swoop curve poses, a four-way stroke texture matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray), and a travel-aligned head-arrival stretch pulse with spring recovery; boils while on screen

blocks.title: Hand-Drawn Boil
blocks.description: Hand-drawn jitter that re-poses every N frames, as seek-safe helpers: pose derives from quantized timeline time through a seeded hash; includes the shared onUpdate dispatcher, a wobbled-ellipse path generator, the boil pose control (off/calm/lively over the family-locked frameDrop), a curvature-adaptive pen-velocity ease, and the completed stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray — spray is index-seeded deterministic dots, no turbulence) with texture-safe draw-on

blocks.title: Hand-Drawn Box Label
blocks.description: Wobbled rounded rectangle draws on — across the authored stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray) — or drops in and lands with a volume-true contact squash and bouncy spring recovery, with a handwritten label above or centered; boils

blocks.title: Scribble Callout Circle
blocks.description: Wobbled ellipse draws around a target with optional scribble fill and curved connector; the handwritten label pops in WITH momentum and the drawn shapes absorb the arrival with a volume-preserving contact squash; outline and connector take the family stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray); boils

blocks.title: Sketched Frame
blocks.description: Media in a hand-drawn border with corner doodles and a handwritten caption; the unit tilts slightly and boils (images inside the block; keep live footage in the host)

blocks.title: Text Along a Path
blocks.description: Handwriting flowing along any SVG path with a per-character reveal; the path is the only geometry input

blocks.title: Hand-Drawn Flowchart
blocks.description: Wobbled boxes with handwritten labels joined by curved connectors, drawing on in sequence from a node list

blocks.title: Scribble Transition
blocks.description: Overlay transition: scribble bands accumulate to cover the frame with a solid backstop, the host cuts beneath, and the scribble clears

blocks.title: Speech Bubble
blocks.description: Hand-drawn speech bubble with a positionable tail: outline draws on, paper fill fades in, handwritten text types per character; boils

blocks.title: Handwritten Title
blocks.description: Handwritten display text with a scalar-driven word-by-word highlight sweep and a seeded squiggle underline sized to the text; boils

blocks.title: Squiggle Marks
blocks.description: Hand-drawn squiggle underline, double-pass strikethrough, and bracket marks that draw on

blocks.title: Handwritten Write-On Title
blocks.description: True glyph write-on: filled Caveat letterforms revealed by baked per-glyph centerline strokes traced in real stroke order with a curvature-adaptive pen-velocity ease (fast on straights, slow into curves, inter-stroke pen lifts); optional squiggle underline; boils

blocks.description: Portrait media filling a widescreen frame via blurred-scale, mirror, or copy side fills; grid texture and foreground contrast lift (images inside the block; keep live footage in the host)

blocks.title: Zoom Through Transition
blocks.description: A transition that zooms through a focal card into the next scene.

variables.label: Outgoing label
variables.description: Caption on the outgoing scene, the one on screen when the transition starts.

variables.label: Incoming label
variables.description: Caption on the incoming scene, the one the timeline wipes into frame.

variables.label: Depth
variables.description: Multiplies how far both scenes travel and how hard the outgoing one blurs, so the push covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Theme token for the ring marking the incoming scene. Blue rides --accent, green --brand, violet --accent-2; each falls back to a neutral hairline.
